items.title: When it came to Cal AI’s viral success, a small army of influencers paid off
items.summary: The company generated over $30 million in revenue in two years and was acquired by MyFitnessPal for an undisclosed amount of money in March.
items.author: Lucas Ropek

items.title: Meta launches an open-weight AI model that runs on Macs
items.summary: Meta and Apple have teamed up for the launch of the social media giant's newest model, Muse Spark Open, which will run locally on Apple silicon.
items.author: Lucas Ropek

items.title: Amazon devices chief Panos Panay sees a future where AI devices replace the need to use apps
items.summary: Speaking at TechCrunch Disrupt, Amazon devices chief Panos Panay described a future where ambient AI devices work in the background, anticipating users' needs instead of waiting for commands.
items.author: Sarah Perez

items.title: Anthropic is letting METR researchers look under the hood with employee-level access
items.summary: METR will publish its own assessments of Anthropic’s risks, incidents, and practices, and the frontier AI model maker has given up the right to block them.
items.author: Aditya Mehta

items.title: Bluesky expands its AI-powered Attie app to let anyone build websites, games, and more
items.summary: Bluesky is bringing “social vibe coding” to its experimental Attie platform, allowing users to create interactive experiences like games, quizzes, and websites that can tap into the social network's audience.
items.author: Sarah Perez

items.title: Last chance to save up to $200 on your TechCrunch Founder Summit pass: Early booking ends October 16
items.summary: Savings of up to $200 end October 16 for TechCrunch Founder Summit. These savings for Founder and Investor Passes vanish after Friday. Join 1,000 founders and investors on November 4 at Boston’s SoWa Power Station. Bring your toughest questions and make the day count for your business.

items.title: AI agents are coming to Rivian’s cars
items.summary: We'll likely learn more about how this will work at the company's upcoming "AI & Autonomy Day" event in December.
items.author: Sean O'Kane

items.title: Google’s Universal Cart shopping tool launches in the US
items.summary: The new shopping tool is available in the U.S. across Google Search and the Gemini app.
items.author: Lauren Forristal

items.author: TechCrunch Events

items.title: Amazon’s Bee launches two new personal AI devices, starting at $75
items.summary: Amazon-owned Bee has launched its first new AI devices since its acquisition, including an updated wearable and a credit-card-sized recorder that attaches to smartphones. The devices can summarize conversations, create to-do lists, and integrate with Alexa and Amazon shopping, with prices starting at $74.99.
items.author: Sarah Perez
